description: This Java source file contains unit tests for the MessageAggregator class within the org.eclipse.ditto.services.concierge.actors.cleanup.credits package. The tests utilize Akka TestKit to verify actor behavior such as message aggregation, self-termination, ignoring irrelevant messages, and reporting on timeouts.

classes.name: MessageAggregatorTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing the MessageAggregator actor's behavior, including message aggregation, self-termination, ignoring invalid messages, and timeout behavior within the Akka actor system.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initializes the ActorSystem before each test.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Shuts down the ActorSystem after each test.

methods.name: stopSelfIfExpectNoMessage
methods.description: Tests that the actor terminates if no messages are received aside from the initial trigger.

methods.name: aggregateMessagesAndStopSelf
methods.description: Verifies that the actor aggregates messages until the limit is reached, then stops.

methods.name: ignoreIrrelevantMessages
methods.description: Ensures that messages of irrelevant types are ignored and do not affect aggregation.

methods.name: reportPartialMessagesOnTimeout
methods.description: Checks that the actor reports partially accumulated messages when a timeout occurs.
